objective: Progress from trustworthy neural activation measurements to causal pre-movement left/right decoding, action-conditioned system identification, and uncertainty-gated inverse control.

gates.label: Activation precision is measurable and robust
evidence: Learnable-direct v3 tied frozen raw-direct at 0.6056 mean sparse-positive held-out recall.
Existing labels contain 79 burst rows across 27 unique ROIs.
blockers: No exhaustively reviewed spatial-temporal evaluation panel exists, so ordinary precision is not identifiable.
pass_criteria: Exhaustive held-out tiles support object and event PR/FROC metrics.
The selected detector meets pre-registered recall and false-positive targets across fish/session and artifact strata.

gates.label: Causal pre-movement intent data are ready
evidence: The existing 11-video latent smoke test is video-level and weakly separable.
blockers: Frame-synchronized movement onset, direction, uncertainty, and leakage-guarded trial windows are not yet available as a frozen dataset.
pass_criteria: Aligned trial manifest passes fish/session, class-balance, missingness, and timing-uncertainty checks.
Every neural feature window ends before the movement-onset uncertainty guard.

gates.label: Left/right intent generalizes
evidence: The current ridge latent head reached 0.3636 accuracy, equal to the majority baseline.
blockers: Intent data gate has not passed.
pass_criteria: A pre-registered model improves held-out balanced accuracy, macro F1, and calibration over behavior-only and population-only baselines.
Spatial and temporal leakage controls pass on held-out fish or sessions.

gates.label: Stimulation actions are identifiable
evidence: Inverse-dynamics export and timestamp-alignment utilities exist.
blockers: Requested and measured stimulation actions, timing, target, amplitude, duration, sham status, and safety interventions are not populated.
pass_criteria: Safe counterbalanced action coverage and no-action/sham controls exist.
Requested-versus-measured action and latency residuals meet the acquisition contract.

gates.label: Action-conditioned transitions are calibrated
pass_criteria: Action-conditioned models beat action-free models on held-out sessions and supported stimulation levels.
Target and off-target outcomes are calibrated and uncertainty rises outside training support.

gates.label: Constrained control works in simulation
pass_criteria: Uncertainty-gated MPC beats no-action, fixed-safe, and randomized-safe policies.
All simulated actions remain inside the approved envelope and unsupported trajectories abstain.

gates.label: Shadow and closed-loop deployment are safe
evidence: Latency p50/p95/p99 instrumentation exists in the repository.
blockers: No simulator pass, shadow-mode evidence, approved action envelope, or command interlock exists.
pass_criteria: Shadow-mode latency, drift, abstention, and watchdog tests pass.
Explicit safety and experimental approvals are recorded before command-capable execution.

experiments.title: Exhaustive activation annotation panel
experiments.hypothesis: A stratified exhaustive panel will reveal that current false-positive burden is concentrated in motion, bright-background, overlap, and detector-disagreement strata.
experiments.decision: Determine whether detector precision is measurable and which error strata dominate the next model comparison.
success_criteria: At least 120 stratified spatial-temporal tiles receive explicit exhaustive, candidate-review, or sparse-positive coverage labels.
A dual-reviewed subset reports agreement and adjudication.
Every unmatched candidate has a valid known-negative or unknown interpretation.
stop_conditions: Stop if coordinate/frame overlays reveal a convention mismatch.
Stop if fewer than three independent sessions or videos can be represented.

experiments.title: Frozen detector and structured-background tournament
experiments.hypothesis: Preserving absolute amplitude while modeling spatially structured background and trace kinetics will improve recall at fixed false-positive burden over pure learned contrast.
experiments.decision: Select the measurement pipeline that supplies intent features; decide whether a learnable refinement is warranted.

design.split_unit: held-out fish if available, otherwise session/video

success_criteria: A frozen operating point improves both event precision and recall over raw-direct with group-bootstrap uncertainty excluding zero.
Attribution, duplicate, split, and merge errors are reported separately.
stop_conditions: Do not tune on the sealed test panel.
Stop model expansion if no method beats raw-direct across at least two independent groups.

experiments.title: Structured-background and PU refinement
experiments.hypothesis: A soma-excluding annular background model plus non-negative positive-unlabeled risk will reduce false detections without sacrificing the raw-direct recall advantage.
experiments.decision: Decide whether learnable detection adds value after the evaluation target and background model are corrected.

design.split_unit: held-out fish if available, otherwise session/video

success_criteria: The confirmatory model improves event average precision and recall at the pre-registered burden over the best frozen pipeline.
The result persists across seeds and independent groups.
stop_conditions: Stop after the 12-job screen if no validation-group improvement is observed.
Abort a job before OOM when GPU memory reaches the 9,600 MiB hard limit.

experiments.title: Causal intent dataset and alignment audit
experiments.hypothesis: The present video-level left/right/neutral labels obscure trial-level pre-movement signal and contain alignment and annotation risks that must be resolved before modeling.
experiments.decision: Determine whether the available acquisitions can support held-out causal intent decoding or whether new synchronized data are required.
success_criteria: Movement onset, direction, uncertainty, fish/session/trial IDs, and pre-onset windows are explicit.
The 1,118-frame interval, reversed range, and workbook-title mismatch are reviewed.
A frozen group split and class-balance report are written.
stop_conditions: Stop modeling if behavior onset cannot be synchronized inside the shortest intended lead window.
Stop if held-out fish/session groups cannot be formed without leakage.

experiments.title: Spatial, temporal, and spatiotemporal intent ablation
experiments.hypothesis: Signed bilateral spatial activity will add predictive information beyond population amount, while slow recent state will add complementary information rather than being safely ignored.
experiments.decision: Choose the minimal generalizing intent representation and quantify whether spatial laterality or temporal state carries the incremental signal.

design.split_unit: held-out fish; held-out session only when fish count is insufficient

success_criteria: A pre-onset representation beats behavior-only and population-only baselines on held-out groups.
Spatial gain collapses under coordinate shuffle/mirroring and temporal gain collapses under time shift.
Calibration and group-bootstrap uncertainty are reported.
stop_conditions: Do not add nonlinear capacity until a regularized linear representation shows stable above-baseline information.
Stop if improvement appears only in post-onset windows.

experiments.title: Stimulation action and safety logging audit
experiments.hypothesis: The current acquisitions lack measured-action and safety fields required to identify a causal stimulation response.
experiments.decision: Freeze the acquisition contract and determine which fields or experiments must be added before system identification.
success_criteria: Requested and measured action, target, amplitude, duration, waveform, command/hardware timestamps, latency, sham, clipping, and interlock fields are frozen.
Unknown action is distinct from observed no-action.
stop_conditions: Do not collect policy-driven data until a safe randomized/counterbalanced acquisition plan is approved.
Do not infer no-stimulation from a missing log.

experiments.title: Action-conditioned linear system-identification pilot
experiments.hypothesis: A controlled linear or preferential-subspace model will predict direction and neural response better than an action-free model within supported state-action regions.
experiments.decision: Establish whether stimulation has identifiable state-dependent effects before training a nonlinear controller model.

design.split_unit: held-out fish/session and held-out stimulation level

success_criteria: Action-conditioned prediction beats action-free prediction on held-out groups and stimulation levels.
Target and off-target effects are calibrated with support diagnostics.
stop_conditions: Stop if action support is confounded with pre-action state.
Stop if measured delivery or latency quality fails the acquisition contract.

experiments.title: Uncertainty-gated MPC simulation
experiments.hypothesis: A constrained controller using action-conditioned ensemble uncertainty will outperform safe baselines while abstaining outside training support.
experiments.decision: Determine whether the learned system is ready for shadow-mode control evaluation.
success_criteria: MPC improves desired-direction probability over all safe baselines without a constraint violation.
Uncertainty gating abstains on unsupported trajectories and degrades safely under perturbations.
stop_conditions: No command-capable adapter may be enabled by this experiment.
Stop if any simulated action exceeds the explicit safety envelope.
Abort a job before OOM when GPU memory reaches the 9,600 MiB hard limit.
